description: Returns a player's career profile for dynasty questions: draft year, round, pick and team, college, age, years in the league, plus his fantasy points season by season (2020 on) and career totals in the chosen scoring. Use it for "how old is he?", "where was he drafted?" and "how has he trended year to year?". Basic plan and above.

player_id.description: GridIron player id, "First Last#POS", matched case-insensitively. Defenses are "Team Name#DST". Unsure of the id? Call search_players first.
player_id.title: Player Id

scoring.description: Fantasy scoring: ppr (full PPR, the default), half (half-PPR) or standard.
scoring.title: Scoring

name: get_player_career

career_totals.description: seasons, games, points, points_per_game and best_season across those seasons.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: what went wrong.

note.description: How age, years_in_league and the seasons are counted.

profile.description: drafted, draft_year, draft_round, draft_pick, draft_team, age_at_draft, college, birth_date, rookie_season, age (today) and years_in_league (rookie season through the current one). Null when not loaded for him.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason, e.g. basic_required or pro_required.

required_plan.description: The plan that unlocks this data: basic or pro.

seasons.description: One row per season GridIron holds stats for (2020 on): season, team, games, points, points_per_game, points_from, position_rank (when known) and scoring_note.

source.description: Attribution: nflverse players and draft_picks, CC-BY-4.0.

status.description: HTTP status of the failed API call.

title: Career profile (dynasty)
